arguments.text: 10 km, 8 legs of 1250 m out-and-back. Goal: even effort that empties the reserve at the finish: pod ~200 W (boat ~132 W) once the hard start settles (by ~3 min). Lean slightly harder on legs against the current, easier with it. Check critical power from the heart-rate trend at steady effort (levels off = below CP; keeps climbing = above). Final push from ~800 m to go. Watch for: weed on rudder (GPS speed drops at same pod power and HR -> clear_rudder), pod drift (pod power moves but HR and boat speed do not -> pod_gain belief), wind/current shifts, radio messages (course change -> set_race_distance and tell). Save cues: max 20.
